descriptions.home: Taipei International Church (TIC) is a multicultural, multigenerational, English-speaking church in Dazhi, Taipei. Sunday worship 10:30 AM in person, 11:00 AM online.
descriptions.about-us: About Taipei International Church: a non-denominational, English-speaking church in Taipei since 1957, welcoming people from every nation and background.
descriptions.beliefs: What Taipei International Church believes: the Apostles' Creed as our statement of faith and the Bible as the supreme authority in all it teaches.
descriptions.vision: The vision, mission and values of Taipei International Church: disciples who shine the light of God's love on Taipei, Taiwan and the world.
descriptions.constitution: The constitution of Taipei International Church, an English-speaking international church in Taipei, Taiwan.
descriptions.history: The history of Taipei International Church, from its first service in October 1957 to its home in Dazhi today, and the pastors who have served.
descriptions.meettheteam: Meet the pastor, staff and elders of Taipei International Church in Dazhi, Taipei.
descriptions.stories: Stories and testimonies from the Taipei International Church family about what God is doing in Taipei and around the world.
descriptions.whatshappening: What's happening at Taipei International Church: this Sunday's service, Bible studies, Worship Circle, men's and women's groups.
descriptions.tic-calendar: Calendar of services and events at Taipei International Church in Dazhi, Taipei.
descriptions.families: Families at Taipei International Church: nursery, TIC Kids (Pre-K to grade 5) and Youth Service on Sundays in Dazhi, Taipei.
descriptions.giving: Give to Taipei International Church by credit card, domestic bank transfer or overseas wire.
descriptions.connect: Meet people at Taipei International Church. Whether you are new to Taiwan or a local, join a group or a serving team.
descriptions.groups: Small groups at Taipei International Church: Bible studies, prayer meetings, young adults, men's and women's groups, and the Filipino Ministry.
descriptions.serve: Serve at Taipei International Church on the worship, welcome, tech, media, kids, youth or hospitality team.
descriptions.contact: Contact Taipei International Church: B1, No. 41, Aly. 7, Ln. 397, Mingshui Rd., Zhongshan Dist., Taipei. Email info@taipeichurch.org.
descriptions.event-list: Upcoming events at Taipei International Church in Taipei.
